استأثروا (form X)
# اِسْتَأْثَرُوا (istaʔṯarū) /is.taʔ.θa.ruː/: third-person masculine plural past active of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
# اِسْتَأْثِرُوا (istaʔṯirū) /is.taʔ.θi.ruː/: second-person masculine plural imperative of اِسْتَأْثَرَ (istaʔṯara)
